projects.title: Your projects
projects.empty: Start from a template below: dimensions, structure and material are adjusted afterwards.
projects.name: Project name
projects.confirmDelete: Delete this project? This is permanent.
projects.nameHint: Leave empty to reuse the template name.
projects.subtitle: Your manufacturing drafts and assemblies in progress.

presets.title: Templates
presets.help: Every project starts from a template, then gets adjusted. Nothing is drawn from scratch.

designer.selectPart: Click a part in the 3D view or in the list.
designer.roundedDisplay: Displayed to the nearest sixteenth. Model value: {{exact}}.
designer.respectGrainHint: For a wood decor. Visible parts will no longer be rotated when nesting, which may cost an extra panel.
designer.reorderHint: Drag a compartment to reorder it, or use the arrows.

warning.SHELF_DEFLECTION: A shelf sags beyond the allowed limit. Shorten the span or use a thicker panel.
warning.NO_BACK_PANEL: Without a back panel the carcass racks over time.
warning.FRONT_GAP_OFF_DIVIDER: A front gap does not sit on its divider.
warning.COMPARTMENT_TOO_NARROW: A bay is too narrow for what it must hold.
warning.DRAWER_DOES_NOT_FIT: A drawer does not fit its bay: no parts are produced for it.
warning.DOOR_DOES_NOT_FIT: A door leaf does not fit its bay: no parts are produced for it.
warning.DOOR_LEAF_TOO_WIDE: A door leaf is wide: it will pull on its hinges and end up rubbing. Fit a pair.
warning.NO_SLIDE_FITS: No off-the-shelf slide fits {{usableDepthMm}} mm of usable depth: the drawer is left undrilled.
warning.COMPARTMENT_WIDTH_MISMATCH: The fixed widths add up to {{requestedMm}} mm for {{availableMm}} mm available.
warning.PULL_WITHOUT_FACADE: A handle in compartment {{compartment}} no longer has a facade.
warning.PULL_OFF_FACADE: A handle overhangs its {{facadeWidthMm}} × {{facadeHeightMm}} mm facade.

manufacturing.unplaced: No sheet can hold: {{parts}}. Make the unit smaller or pick another sheet size.
manufacturing.incomplete: {{count}} prices still to enter: no total is shown while any is missing.
manufacturing.dimensionsIn: Dimensions shown in your unit system, for example {{example}}.
manufacturing.priceHelp: Prices are entered once and remembered for your organisation. Neftya invents no rates: a wrong quote is worse than no quote.
manufacturing.noDrilling: Nothing to drill on this piece: no adjustable shelf, no door, no drawer, no divider.
manufacturing.opensLeft: Opens to the left — hinges on the right
manufacturing.opensRight: Opens to the right — hinges on the left

assembly.carcass: Join the bottom to the sides, sides inside, flush with the edges.
assembly.top: Fit the top onto the sides, flush with the edges.
assembly.dividers: Set the dividers plumb between bottom and top.
assembly.shelves: Rest the shelves on their supports.
assembly.back: Slide the back into its groove, then check the carcass is square.
assembly.drawers: Build the drawer boxes: sides, front, back, then bottom.
assembly.drawer_faces: Fit the faces onto the boxes, with an even gap between them.
assembly.doors: Hang the doors last, then adjust the hinges: an even gap all the way round.

plans.pdfInMillimetres: The PDF is dimensioned in millimetres: it goes to the workshop, where a display preference has no bearing.

exports.title: Frozen exports
exports.none: No frozen export for this project.

settings.title: Settings
settings.currencyHelp: Used for quotes. XOF and XAF have no decimals.
settings.unitSystemHelp: Starting value for the organisation. Anyone can switch their own display.

panel.lastOpen: The last open panel cannot be collapsed.

templates.nameFrHint: Required: it is the reference language, the one used as fallback.
templates.nameEnHint: Optional. Without a translation, the French name is shown everywhere.

account.switchFailed: Could not switch. Your access may have been revoked.

assistant.title: Describe the furniture
assistant.help: Write what you want to build, in a sentence or two. The proposed configuration is shown before any project is created.
assistant.label: The description
assistant.hint: Give sizes in millimetres: “1800 wide, 2000 high, 400 deep”.
assistant.placeholder: A bookcase 1800 by 2000, 400 deep, three compartments with two shelves each, in MDF
assistant.unusable: The description is not enough to compose a piece of furniture. Clarify the following, then try again.
assistant.failed: The interpretation did not complete. Rephrase, or start from a preset.
assistant.timeout: The interpretation is taking too long. Rephrase, or start from a preset.
assistant.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 3 MB at most. A front view is enough.
assistant.widthHint: Leave empty: the assistant proposes a width from the furniture it recognises, and you correct it.
assistant.photoTooHeavy: Photo too heavy: 3 MB at most.
assistant.photoMissing: Choose a photo and give the width.
assistant.depthHint: Leave this empty too: a front view shows no depth, so it will be proposed.

cuttingOrder.title: Cutting list — store
cuttingOrder.lead: Hand this to the cutting desk. You buy the boards, the store cuts them: only finished sizes matter here — saw kerf and trimming are their business.
cuttingOrder.grainLocked: along the length, do not rotate
cuttingOrder.tooSmall: The smallest size is {{size}} mm. Many stores refuse cuts below {{limit}} mm — ask before you pay for the boards.

joinery.dowelHint: Invisible, but needs a doweling jig: both holes must line up to a tenth of a millimetre.
joinery.screwHint: Heads show on the top and bottom. A drill is all you need, and the piece comes apart again.
